scope: Packed Shipyard remodel, rename, and equipment tutorial messages

records.english: I'll help, Admiral. / I'll help refit, Admiral.
records.context: Two independently addressed companion offers to assist with a refit.
records.notes: Preserves the second entry at byte 21 and gives both ASCII entries a two-byte rendering guard.

records.context: Two companion refit offers, the helper discount, and both ship-renaming prompts.
records.notes: Preserves entry starts at bytes 29, 49, 117, and 145. The literal percent is escaped as %% for the runtime formatter.

records.english: Which ship to refit? / It'll take %s days.
records.notes: Preserves the duration entry at byte 25.

records.english: Gunners speed up cannon fire. Up to four rooms. / Stores water and food.
